_comment: The same three site changes, flattened. Every historical URL points straight at the URL that serves the content today, in one 301 hop.

redirects._comment: Both historical product URLs point at the destination directly. When a destination moves again, every rule that pointed at it is rewritten to the new target rather than a new rule being appended. That rewrite is the whole discipline; a map only grows chains when the easy option is taken instead.
One direction only. The reverse rule was deleted rather than left in place, because a loop is two correct rules in the same file.
